events.title: ALGOL 58
events.detail: The Zurich report; ALGOL 60 (Paris, January 1960) followed. The first language standards named for their year.

events.title: FORTRAN 66
events.detail: ANSI X3.9-1966, approved March 1966. FORTRAN 77 (approved 1978, named for its drafts), 90, 95, 2003, 2008 kept the habit.

events.title: Ada 83
events.detail: ANSI/MIL-STD-1815A. Ada 95, 2005, 2012, and 2022 followed.

events.title: C89
events.detail: ANSI X3.159-1989; ISO's C90 is the same language. C99, C11, C17, and C23 kept the year.

events.title: tz database "Release 92"
events.detail: Olson/IANA tz releases named 92, 92c, 93b…; four-digit years from 1996m. pytz mirrors them from 2004a.

events.title: Windows 95
events.detail: Office 95 shipped the same day and Office 97 in November 1996. The year becomes a consumer version number.

events.title: Visual Studio 97
events.detail: The first Visual Studio, year-named; Visual Studio 2005 through 2022 kept the YYYY on the box.

events.title: C++98
events.detail: ISO/IEC 14882:1998, the first C++ standard. C++03 is 0Y; C++11 through C++26 are YY.

events.title: Windows 98
events.detail: Retail June 25, 1998; Second Edition June 1999.

events.title: C99
events.detail: ISO/IEC 9899:1999; ANSI adopted it in March 2000.

events.title: Windows 2000
events.detail: The first four-digit-year Windows. Windows Me and SQL Server 2000 followed the same year.

events.title: Ubuntu 4.10 "Warty Warthog"
events.detail: YY.0M from the first release. 6.06 LTS was planned as 6.04 and renumbered when it slipped.

events.title: youtube-dl 2006.08.08
events.detail: YYYY.0M.0D from the first 223-line release.

events.title: Twisted 10.0.0
events.detail: After 8.2 and 9.0, Twisted goes YY.MINOR (now YY.M.MICRO).

events.title: C++11 and C11
events.detail: Published September and December 2011; C++ settles into a three-year cadence named by year.

events.title: Stripe API 2011-06-21
events.detail: The oldest version in Stripe's API changelog; every breaking change since is a dated version.

events.title: Minecraft snapshot 11w47a
events.detail: The first Java Edition snapshot and the first use of YYw0Wa week naming.

events.title: NixOS 13.10 "Aardvark"
events.detail: The first stable NixOS, YY.0M like Ubuntu.

events.title: certifi 14.05.14
events.detail: The first dated certifi, after 1.0.1; YYYY.M.D from 2015 onward.

events.title: Adobe Creative Cloud 2014
events.detail: Photoshop CC 2014 (v15) adds the year to every app name. "CC" was dropped with Photoshop 2020; the year stayed.

events.title: ECMAScript 2015
events.detail: ES6 renamed ECMAScript 2015; a YYYY edition every June since.

events.title: Windows 10 version 1507
events.detail: Builds numbered YY0M (1507, 1511… 2004), then YYH1/YYH2 from 20H2 in October 2020.

events.title: boltons 15.0.0
events.detail: From 0.6.6 to YY.MINOR.MICRO; the switch that led to "Designing a Version".

events.title: Kali Linux 2016.1
events.detail: Kali goes rolling and 2.0 becomes YYYY.MINOR.

events.title: "Designing a Version"
events.detail: The sedimental.org post on SemVer's failure modes that names CalVer and seeds calver.org.

events.title: JetBrains 2016.1
events.detail: Every IDE aligned on YYYY.MINOR; IntelliJ IDEA 16 ships as 2016.1.

events.title: calver.org goes live
events.detail: Overview, users list, and badges; spec 16.6. The repo started March 25, 2016.

events.title: "Announcing CalVer"
events.detail: The announcement post, and the first Hacker News submission (3 points).

events.title: Mesa 17.0.0
events.detail: 13.x to YY.MINOR.MICRO.

events.title: Unity 2017.1
events.detail: YYYY.MINOR from 2017.1 through 2022.3 LTS; Unity 6 (October 2024) went back to a plain major.

events.title: Black 18.3a0
events.detail: YY.M from the first PyPI upload.

events.title: 0ver.org
events.detail: ZeroVer, the satirical sibling site: 29 points on Hacker News that day, 570 on a 2021 repost.

events.title: calver.org on the HN front page
events.detail: "Calendar Versioning": 108 points, 43 comments.

events.title: pip 18.0
events.detail: 10.0.1 to YY.MINOR; the most-installed CalVer project.

events.title: ClickHouse 18.1.0
events.detail: Changelog: "changed the numbering scheme." The previous release, eleven days earlier, was 1.1.54394.

events.title: pycalver (now bumpver)
events.detail: Manuel Barkhau's pattern-based version bumper, first on PyPI as pycalver 201809.2b0; renamed bumpver in October 2020.

events.title: CockroachDB 19.1
events.detail: "Why we're switching to calendar versioning": 2.1 to YY.MINOR.MICRO.

events.title: Shopify API 2019-04
events.detail: Quarterly YYYY-0M API versions, each supported for at least twelve months.

events.title: CalVer spec 19.7
events.detail: Revised text, case studies, and users list; the overview becomes software-agnostic.

events.title: calver.org on the HN front page, again
events.detail: 194 points, 99 comments; the thread's complaint that DD should mean the padded day shaped the 26.0 tokens.

events.title: node-calver
events.detail: Murat Gözel's parser and bumper for Node, published to npm as calver 20.5.1.

events.title: Chinese translation
events.detail: The 中文 overview, translated by 狂飙 (networm).

events.title: calver setuptools plugin
events.detail: Dustin Ingram's use_calver=True for setuptools, versioned 2020.6.19; used by PyPA's trove-classifiers.

events.title: Home Assistant 2020.12
events.detail: 0.118 to YYYY.M.MICRO, released monthly on the first Wednesday.

events.title: Spring Cloud 2020.0.0
events.detail: Release trains leave London tube stations (Hoxton) for YYYY.MINOR.MICRO.

events.title: yt-dlp 2021.01.07
events.detail: The fork keeps youtube-dl's YYYY.0M.0D.

events.title: structlog 21.1.0
events.detail: Hynek Schlawack moves structlog, then attrs (21.2.0, May 2021), to YY.MINOR.MICRO.

events.title: NVIDIA RAPIDS 21.06
events.detail: 0.19 to YY.0M across the RAPIDS libraries.

events.title: Android Studio Arctic Fox 2020.3.1
events.detail: Would have been 4.3; adopts the IntelliJ platform's year numbering.

events.title: xarray 2022.3.0
events.detail: 0.21 to YYYY.M.MICRO.

events.title: conda 22.9.0
events.detail: CEP 8: 4.14 to YY.M.MICRO.

events.title: NVIDIA GPU Operator 22.9.0
events.detail: 1.11 to YY.M.MICRO; the twelve-month support window reads off the version.

events.title: OpenStack 2023.1 "Antelope"
events.detail: After Zed, YYYY.MINOR; also the first SLURP release.

events.title: Portuguese translation
events.detail: The pt-BR overview, contributed by souovan.

events.title: LibreOffice 24.2
events.detail: 7.6 to YY.M.

events.title: hatch-calver
events.detail: Aarni Koskela's Hatch version-scheme plugin, itself versioned 2024.9.17.

events.title: Stripe 2024-09-30.acacia
events.detail: Dated API versions gain plant-named twice-yearly majors.

events.title: Neo4j 2025.01.0
events.detail: After 5.26 LTS, YYYY.0M.MICRO.

events.title: ScyllaDB 2025.1
events.detail: Enterprise (already 2024.x) and Open Source 6.2 unify on YYYY.MINOR.

events.title: Apple OS 26
events.detail: At WWDC every Apple OS jumps to 26, numbered by the model year ahead; shipped September 15, 2025.

events.title: Betaflight 2025.12
events.detail: The successor to 4.x is 2025.12.0, with June and December majors.

events.title: CalVer spec 26.0
events.detail: Single-letter M, W, D (doubled letters deprecated), bracketed optional segments, padding guidance, a decade of adoption surveyed.

events.title: calver-adoption agent skill
events.detail: A skill that walks a coding agent from detecting the current version to cutting the first calendar release.
